principles: Must-always-run covers repository/build/unit/deterministic authoritative contracts plus the current checkpoint's 108-variant Tactical Power doctrine/reactor sensitivity study.
Deep Calibration remains opt-in unless a checkpoint changes mechanics that require historical stochastic requalification.
The Checkpoint 61 54-variant composed-ship matrix moves out of the normal lineup and remains available in Deep Calibration as historical stochastic regression evidence.
Simulation diagnoses consequences; it does not manufacture fixed build or weapon-family win percentages.
The accepted TL1 production reactor remains 5 Tactical Power. Reactor outputs 4 and 6 are sensitivity probes only.
Weapon capabilities must be judged in contexts that can exercise them. Energy APEN is a latent capability against the current TL1 AP0 armor control and must not be declared worthless from this study.
Sensorless-build outcomes remain established-Firm-track isolation evidence only until sensor/acquisition/EW-coupled validation is performed.
Generated historical checkpoint text logs/manifests/readmes are excluded from current full-repository packaging; machine inputs and explicit evidence are retained.

notes.reasonDeepCalibrationNotRequired: The new doctrine and reactor-output controls are opt-in variant fields; absent fields default to Checkpoint 61 DefenseFirst behavior and the production technology profile remains unchanged.
